summary: Tested Project Communities v2 + Share & Earn referrals (DIYhomie iter 11). Backend: 14/14 pytest passing — community/projects returns 12 seeded communities sorted by stats.completed desc with experience_count populated; community/feed?limit=15 returns recent experiences with project_title and project_slug; community/projects/toilet-replacement returns stats, top_questions, common_mistakes, helpful_tips, experiences[], threads[]; POST experience creates real record (seeded=false), increments experience_count and returns computed badge; cheer increments correctly; thread creation + reply persist with author+badge; auth-gated POSTs return 403 without token; unknown slug/exp_id return 404. /api/referrals/me returns code, invited, converted, earned_cents, credit_cents, reward_cents=500, is_paid; registering with a valid ref code creates a referrals row and bumps the demo user's invited counter; bad ref code does not block registration; /referrals/me requires auth. Frontend (mobile 390x844): logged in as demo user; /community shows JUST COMPLETED feed (15 cards) + BROWSE BY PROJECT (12 cards); tapping community-project-toilet-replacement opens /community/toilet-replacement with stats grid (Completed/Avg time/Difficulty/Avg cost/Success/Stories), community-ai-cta visible, cheer-* increments, ask-question-btn modal submits TEST question, share-experience-btn modal submits TEST experience successfully; /referrals (Share & Earn) reachable directly, profile tab shows profile-referrals card, AppMenu has menu-referrals item (testID present in source). 0 pageerrors across the flow. No deprecated Expo packages on the new code (community + referrals screens use only expo-router, expo-haptics, expo-clipboard).
action_items: (Optional cleanup) Community DB now contains a few TEST_ rows from regression (TEST_exp_*, TEST_UI_q, TEST_UI Done in 90 min) and a couple of throwaway @example.com referral users — safe to leave; if desired they can be purged by filtering created docs with TEST_ prefix in title/question and email starting with test_ref_/test_badref_.
(Nice-to-have) Consider returning created_at + cheers in the cheer response for consumers that want to optimistically update the card (currently only returns {cheers}).
(Nice-to-have) /api/community/projects could accept a ?limit= param; currently capped at 200 which is fine for now but worth documenting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2135 lines — close to the 700-line soft cap noted in the code review guide. Consider splitting community + referrals into their own routers for maintainability.
Community POSTs correctly require Bearer auth (Depends(get_current_user)) and validate slug existence before insert. Good.
_exp_public() strips _id from responses — no MongoDB ObjectId leakage observed. Good.

link_referral() is idempotent on a fresh user but does NOT block self-referral by code (it only blocks when referrer.id == new_user_id which is fine post-insert). No abuse vector since reward only fires on subscription.
/referrals/me lazily mints a referral_code if the user lacks one — good for legacy users.
Community experience badge is computed from user's TOTAL experience count across ALL projects, not per-project — this matches the 'verified DIYer' intent. Documented for the next agent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (community hub + detail + experience + thread + cheer + referrals screen all working, 0 pageerrors)

seed_data_creation: Tests added 1 real experience + 1 thread + 1 reply on toilet-replacement (prefixed TEST_), 2 throwaway @example.com referral users (test_ref_* and test_badref_*) plus 1 UI-submitted experience and 1 UI question on toilet-replacement. All non-destructive to seeded data.

Community testIDs: community-project-{slug}, feed-{id}, community-ai-cta, share-experience-btn, ask-question-btn, cheer-{id}, ex-title/ex-body/ex-tools/ex-cost/ex-min/ex-submit, ask-input/ask-submit, reply-input-{tid}/reply-send-{tid}/reply-open-{tid}. Referrals testIDs: referral-copy, referral-share. Profile path /profile has profile-referrals; AppMenu (open via home-menu) has menu-referrals. The 'demo_home@diyhomie.com / Test1234' user has been used in iter 11 tests; its referrals.invited counter now reflects 1+ test registrations.
